name: modify-labels
description: Adds or removes Gmail labels on a thread or message. Thread and message IDs come from gmail__search-messages; label IDs come from gmail__list-labels. Shortcuts: archive, markRead, markUnread, star, and unstar.

threadId.description: Thread ID from gmail__search-messages or gmail__get-message. Provide exactly one of threadId or messageId.

messageId.description: Message ID from gmail__search-messages. Provide exactly one of threadId or messageId.

addLabelIds.description: Label IDs to add, from gmail__list-labels.

removeLabelIds.description: Label IDs to remove, from gmail__list-labels.
